blocks.content: The ball is bouncing. But there is nothing to catch it yet.
The paddle is a horizontal bar that sits near the bottom of the canvas. It always stays at the same vertical position. Only its horizontal position changes during gameplay.
You draw it with ctx.roundRect(), which works like a regular rectangle but with rounded corners.
Using half the height as the corner radius gives it a pill shape:
The paddle always sits at PADDLE_Y = 320. That constant is already defined. So the only value that changes during the game is this.x.
Next, you will look at how the paddle actually moves in response to keyboard and mouse input.
